FIELDS.NAME: ClearView Glass Solutions
FIELDS.CONTACT FOR INSPECTION: John Doe, Inspection Coordinator, Phone: (555) 123-4567, Email: john.doe@clearviewglass.com
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: At ClearView Glass Solutions, we specialize in providing high-quality glass installation and repair services primarily for residential properties. Our operations include the measurement, cutting, and fitting of various types of glass, ensuring that we adhere strictly to local building codes and safety regulations. We have a dedicated team of skilled technicians who are fully trained in the latest glass handling techniques, optimizing for safety and efficiency. In addition to standard glass services, we also offer light commercial glass work, such as storefront installations for single-story buildings, maintaining a commitment to craft and customer satisfaction. Our equipment is regularly inspected and maintained, and we enforce rigorous load securing protocols when transporting glass to prevent damage during delivery. By focusing predominantly on lower-risk projects and ensuring our safety protocols are documented and regularly updated, we position ourselves as a reliable and trusted glass service provider in the community.
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On March 5, 2023, a minor accident occurred during a residential glass installation when a tempered glass panel slipped from the technician's grip, resulting in a crack. The estimated loss for the replacement of the damaged panel was $1,200. The claim has been settled, and the customer was satisfied with the quick resolution.
FIELDS.HOURS OF OPERATION: Monday to Friday: 8:00 AM - 5:00 PM, Saturday: 9:00 AM - 2:00 PM, Sunday: Closed
FIELDS.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: Class B, Grade II, UL Listed Safe for secure storage of cash and sensitive documents.
FIELDS.OTHER PROTECTION: Security fencing and onsite watchpersons during after-hours operations to enhance property protection.
